'''Eric Wilson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 1999 Seattle tournament]] on 10 October 1999 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]], according to Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d111">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-17-seattle-wa-10-10-99d111/ seattle-wa-10-10-99], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 17 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-17-seattle-wa-10-10-99d111/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
